correctness.rationale: For 0<eta<=1 each mixture p_i=(1-eta)u_i²+eta/m satisfies exactly F(eta)=cos²θ/(1-eta+eta/m)+m sin²θ/eta by Cauchy–Schwarz, with an explicit u,z,w saturating coordinate 1. Optimize F to eta*=m sinθ/[sqrt(m-1)cosθ+(m-1)sinθ] until tanθ=sqrt(m-1), then eta=1. The uniform reference u_i=1/sqrt(m) forces some p_j<=1/m for every arbitrary policy and a feasible w achieves the same lower bound; hence the entire policy infimum is proved, not just mixtures. The θ=0 and π/2 endpoints, zero reference entries, and uniqueness restricted to mixture η are treated correctly. Independent analytic formula/random-vector checks across m=2,3,4,10,30 and 250 trials confirm constraints; finite checks are not the proof.
